id.description: Gets or sets the identifier for the gateway configuration.

userId.description: Gets or sets the user identifier for the gateway configuration.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the gateway.

libraryIds.description: Gets or sets the library IDs allowed in this gateway.

allowedTools.description: Gets or sets a list of allowed tools for the gateway.

allowedToolsByLibrary.description:
Gets or sets the allowed tools scoped per library, keyed by library ID (MCPG-1268).
Null means the gateway still has flat-list semantics only.

allowedSkillsByLibrary.description:
Gets or sets the allowed skills scoped per library, keyed by library ID (MCPG-2072).
Null means the gateway serves every advertised skill.

updatedAt.description: Gets or sets the last updated time.

sharedCredentials.description: Gets or sets the shared credentials mapping library IDs to provider integration IDs.

allowedToolsAll.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether all tools are allowed.

radarEnabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this gateway is surfaced through Radar
in the UI. Metadata only: does not gate Radar routing or runtime behavior.

organicMemoryEnabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this static gateway includes the organic memory library.

level.description:
Gets or sets the access level for this gateway configuration.
Personal: only the creator can see and use this gateway.
Tenant: all users in the tenant can see and use this gateway.

hasStoredTools.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this gateway has stored tool definitions.

hasStoredSkills.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this gateway has stored skill definitions (MCPG-2072).

libraries.description:
Gets or sets display and auth metadata for each library included in this gateway.
Ordered to match List<Guid> GatewayConfigurationResponse.LibraryIds. Populated regardless of the current
tenant's Library Mode (Default/Custom) so callers never need to cross-join this
list against `/api/v1/Library/status` to render a gateway card.
Null until enriched by the service layer; always populated in API responses.

instructions.description:
Gets or sets the markdown instructions for tools in this gateway.
When set, enables the get_tool_instructions native tool.

instructionsToolDescription.description:
Gets or sets a custom description for the get_tool_instructions tool.
If null, uses the default description.

assignedUserIds.description:
Gets or sets the assigned user identifiers (MCPG-1706). Two states on the GET response
(MCPG-2123 baked access assignments always on): an empty list means UNRESTRICTED, and a
populated list means restricted to those users. `null` is not a GET-response arm.

assignedGroupIds.description:
Gets or sets the assigned group identifiers (MCPG-1706), with the same two-state reading
as List<Guid>? GatewayConfigurationResponse.AssignedUserIds.

version.description:
Gets or sets the Postgres xmin concurrency token for this row (MCPG-2094).
JSON number (uint). Null on the InMemory provider. Echo as
`expectedVersion` on a later PUT to refuse a stale full write.

id.description: Gets or sets the library ID.

name.description: Gets or sets the display name of the library.

iconUrl.description: Gets or sets the URL for the library's display icon.

authTypes.description: Gets or sets all auth types the library's catalog entry supports.

oneOf.description:
Gets or sets the auth type currently configured at the tenant level.
Null when the tenant has no integration record for this library yet.

state.description:
Gets or sets the unified connection state — drives the quick-connect
status dot on the card. FE-aligned ubiquitous language.

oauthProviderConfigId.description: Gets or sets the OAuth provider config ID the gateway would use for a Connect action.

GatewayLibrarySummary.description:
Display and auth metadata for a single library included in a gateway configuration.
Populated regardless of the tenant's Library Mode so that gateway cards never
need to cross-join against `/api/v1/Library/status`.

McpConnectionOutcome.description:
Coarse outcome of an MCP server's connection state — the FE-aligned ubiquitous
            language used end-to-end across BE and FE to drive UI affordances.
            One outcome per state; string? McpConnectionState.Reason refines an
McpConnectionOutcome.Error outcome with a machine-readable code from
McpConnectionReasons.

outcome.description: Gets the coarse outcome — the ubiquitous language shared across BE and FE.

disabled.description:
Gets a value indicating whether an admin has disabled this integration at
the tenant level. Orthogonal to McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome: the outcome still
reflects the underlying connection readiness, so re-enabling needs no
re-derivation. Only a configured row can be disabled.

reason.description:
Gets the machine-readable reason from McpConnectionReasons,
or null when none applies. Set for McpConnectionOutcome.Error,
for Connected plus string McpConnectionReasons.RefreshPending, and
for NeedsSetup plus
string McpConnectionReasons.SchemaCredentialNotConfigured.

reasonDetails.description:
Gets optional developer-facing detail refining the reason (e.g. UCS error
code, exception message). May be surfaced in logs and ProblemDetails but
must not be used for end-user UI strings.

interactiveAvailable.description:
Gets a value indicating whether an interactive personal-OAuth connect,
setup, or reconnect can clear this classification. Present as
`true` only for `not_configured`,
`awaiting_credentials`, `credential_invalid`, and
`misconfigured` when the primary credential of an interactive
personal-OAuth source is the cause. Absent (`null`) for
non-interactive sources, Connected results, and reasons a primary
connect cannot clear. Never `false`.

oneOf.description:
Gets the recovery action for this classification. Null on an unstamped
singleton (omitted from JSON and gRPC). A stamped wire state always
carries a value other than RecoveryCommand.Unspecified.
Absent means the client keeps today's derivation. Present is authoritative
and replaces reading string? McpConnectionState.Reason to choose Connect, Reconnect,
Configure, or Save credential.

McpConnectionState.description:
State-only view of an MCP server connection — the wire-shape primitive that
            every transport (REST, gRPC, SignalR push, future Orleans grain messages)
            can carry without dragging the entire `McpServerConfiguration`
            along. The build-outcome wrapper `McpConnectionResult` composes a
            state with the optional built configuration.
            Shape contract:* McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is always set.
* string? McpConnectionState.Reason is set when
                McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is McpConnectionOutcome.Error (from
                McpConnectionReasons), when McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is
                McpConnectionOutcome.Connected and the value is
                string McpConnectionReasons.RefreshPending, or when
                McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is McpConnectionOutcome.NeedsSetup
                and the value is
                string McpConnectionReasons.SchemaCredentialNotConfigured. Other
                Connected and NeedsSetup results keep string? McpConnectionState.Reason null.
                Unknown non-error reasons are informational and never a gate.
* string? McpConnectionState.ReasonDetails is an optional human-readable refinement
                (UCS error code, exception message) intended for logs and developer-facing
                diagnostics — not for end-user UI strings.
* Exception? McpConnectionState.Error is the original exception when the outcome was
                caused by one. Internal use only — never serialized.
* bool McpConnectionState.Disabled is an orthogonal admin-disable flag — it can
                be true alongside any McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome (a Connected or NeedsAuth
                server can still be admin-disabled), so it does not collapse into the
                readiness outcome.
* bool? McpConnectionState.InteractiveAvailable is present (`true`)
                only for a user-recoverable classification of an interactive personal-OAuth
                source. It is omitted (`null`) otherwise and is never
                `false`.
* RecoveryCommand? McpConnectionState.RecoveryCommand is the recovery action. It is omitted
                (`null`) on an unstamped singleton so an old payload stays
                absent. A present value is authoritative. RecoveryCommand.Unspecified
                is never stored.

McpServerAuthType.description: An enumeration representing the authentication types for MCP servers.
